title: ServiceInstance — the registry entry did-management/registry/admin-register returns
description: 0.1's `service-instance` ServiceInstance with its one instant renamed to the registry's `<event>At` convention (`lastSeen` → `lastSeenAt`) and nothing else changed. Kept apart from `service-instance.schema.json`, the richer record the registry reads return, because re-pinning admin-register to that one would change its response beyond the rename. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

RegisteredInstance.title: RegisteredInstance

instanceId.description: Stable identifier the control plane uses for this instance. SHOULD be derived from the instance's DID (e.g. `did:web:host.example` → `did_web_host_example`) so it survives restarts.

servedDomains.description: Hosting domains this instance currently serves. Updated by `domain/assign` / `domain/unassign` ack flow.

RegisteredInstance.description: The `ServiceInstance` shape of `did-management/_shared/0.1`, with `lastSeen` renamed `lastSeenAt`; named apart from `service-instance.schema.json`'s `ServiceInstance`, a different shape, so the two do not collide in generated code.
